Content: <corr id="xd20e39045" title="Source: Nakababuy">Nakabábuy</corr> aku ug tulu ka buuk sa pagbatun ku sa íyang anay,
I got three pigs for taking care of his sow.
Nakabábuy (nakapabábuy) ang mga Písi sa mga Múrus sa pulù,
The P.C. blockaded the Moros on the island.
Nabábuy kami tungud sa dakung bahà,
We were blocked in because of the great flood.
I’m going to checkmate your pawn.
Ang ákung kwarta nabábuy sa nigusyu,
My money is tied up in business.
You just treat me like a pig.
for a scolding to be abusive.
